title: Hourly meteorological dataset from a 40-station network on the NUS campus, Singapore (2025)
description:
Hourly observations of air temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, global horizontal irradiance, wind speed and wind direction from 40 automatic weather stations on the National University of Singapore main campus, 1 January to 31 December 2025, with rainfall at three rooftop stations and station metadata (coordinates, elevation, mounting type).

The release contains the quality-controlled observations (data/raw; one row per logged hour), a gap-filled dataset covering all 8,760 hours with a provenance flag for every value (data/imputed; 0 = observed, 1 = linear interpolation, 2 = XGBoost spatial regression, 3 = not measured/not imputed, 4 = observed air temperature above 37.0 °C), the quality-control log and validation results (data_quality_assessment), figures, and the Python scripts that produce them (code). Gap-filled wind values have little or no skill; use flag 0 values for wind analyses.

Version 1.1.0 adds rule-based quality control (faulty irradiance, pressure and wind records removed and logged), variable-specific interpolation limits and a validation of short-gap interpolation. The unmasked sensor values are preserved in version 1.0.0.

Version 1.2.0 doubles all rainfall values (earlier versions hold about half the rainfall recorded by nearby Meteorological Service Singapore gauges, most likely because each 0.2-mm tip was logged as 0.1 mm), sets rainfall to missing during logger outages (previously stored as 0 mm), adds a rainfall flag, flags air temperatures above 37.0 °C (probable radiation error of the naturally ventilated shields) and corrects the missing-timestamp counts in data_quality_summary.csv. All other values are unchanged from version 1.1.0.
